texts.zh: 似乎有第三方恶意入侵了驻在[Root.Capital.GetName]的[envoy_source.GetAdj]特使，[event_envoy.GetName]所使用的翻译软件，结果不同于平日宽宏的陈词滥调，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]开始恶毒地羞辱，把众人骂了个遍。[event_envoy.GetHerHis]设备的故障已被及时查明，但在此之前[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]已经被说成是“卑鄙的[ruler_species.GetNameInsult]”——他们肯定会对这种严重羞辱加以回应。
texts.en: It appears that a mischievous third party was able to hack into the translation software of the [envoy_source.GetAdj] envoy to [Root.Capital.GetName], [event_envoy.GetName], so that instead of uttering magnanimous platitudes, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] began spewing vicious insults that left none unscathed. The malfunction in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] equipment was duly uncovered, but not before [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] was declared to be a "vile [ruler_species.GetNameInsult]" - a grave insult which surely calls for a response.

texts.zh:
似乎有第三方恶意入侵了我们派往[From.GetName]的特使[event_envoy.GetName]所使用的翻译软件，结果[event_envoy.GetHerHis]原本宽宏的外交辞令变成了恶毒的羞辱，把众人骂了个遍——尤其是他们的[From.GetRulerTitle]，被说成是“卑鄙的[ruler_species.GetNameInsult]”。

尽管故障被迅速查明，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不觉得这个事故好笑，并且正式控诉了我国特使的不当行为。
texts.en:
It appears that a mischievous third party was able to hack into the translation software of our envoy to the [From.GetName], [event_envoy.GetName], so that [event_envoy.GetHerHis] magnanimous platitudes instead became vicious insults that left none unscathed - not least their [From.GetRulerTitle], who was declared to be a "vile [ruler_species.GetNameInsult]".

Although the malfunction was swiftly uncovered, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were not amused at the incident and have lodged an official complaint at the inappropriate behavior of our envoy.

It appears that a mischievous third party was able to hack into the translation software of our envoy to the [From.GetName], [event_envoy.GetName], so that [event_envoy.GetHerHis] magnanimous platitudes instead became vicious insults that left none unscathed - not least their [From.GetRulerTitle], who was declared to be a "vile [ruler_species.GetNameInsult]".

Fortunately, the malfunction was swiftly uncovered and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] took the incident with a sense of humor. Indeed, recordings of the "inappropriate [Root.GetAdj] envoy" are circulating widely, causing much mirth among their people.
